evidence.quote: we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The directive settles an ongoing operational rule and presents rehearsal as a condition of actually having rollback capability; its universal formulation is decision-grade, but not explicit identity-level permanence.
The heading frames what follows as settled, but it is an editorial label rather than a performed ratification and does not independently establish stronger conviction.
The flat cadence statement records a settled operational commitment, though its topic-specific wording does not by itself warrant principle-level conviction.
The unhedged assignment is firm, but this segment records ownership rather than the settling of a conviction-bearing rule.
